lines.zh: 我一步一晃，叶片在头上摇
lines.en: I sway as I walk, leaves nodding overhead.
The bud on my head bobs with each step.
I walk like a small child.
Vines hang from my shoulders.
I thread my way through the flowers.
Small feet, quick steps.
I go around a thick trunk.

lines.zh: 叶子被风吹着打我后背
lines.en: Wind slaps the leaf against my back.
I swing my arms as I go.
The light in this forest is soft.
I tread on fallen leaves; they are loud.

lines.zh: 我停下来摸了摸头上的花
lines.en: I pause and touch the bud on my head.
I crouch to look at a flower.
I smell of soil.
I am trying to make the vine longer.

lines.zh: 叶子在风里一下一下地动
lines.en: My leaf stirs in the wind.
This forest is comfortable to be in.
I push my hands into the soil.
The bud on my head has not opened yet.

lines.zh: 我还能长成更大的样子
lines.en: I can still grow into something bigger.
I am growing.
I wind a vine around my finger.
I tilt my head and listen to the woods.
I look up at you with round eyes.
You must stoop to see me.
The bud on my head wobbles.
Do you mean to touch me?
My hands are vines, very soft.
Do you like plants?
I can help you plant things.
I stand beside you to compare.
Shall I plant a tree for you?
You carry the smell of soil.
When I laugh, my leaf shakes.
I can sit down and wait for you.

lines.zh: 这座林子里有我的朋友
lines.en: I have friends in this forest.
Let me share a tender leaf with you.
I cry out softly and retreat.
A leaf has come off.
I hug myself.
Soil crumbles off me.
A leaf came off, and it really hurts
I can still stand steady.
One vine has snapped.
My body feels weak.
Do not do that again.
Is that fruit?
The flower on my head smells sweet.
I can grow fruit like this myself
I come over in tiny steps.
A little is enough.
I will plant the seed after eating.
This tastes quite good.
This one is too small.
I will share a little with my friends.
I stumble from the bump.
The bud on my head has gone crooked.
My vine has tangled around you.
I loosen it at once.
That nudged me back two small steps.
I sit on the ground and look at you.
Soil falls off my feet.
I was never very sturdy.
You bumped me again.
I am still small.
I must grow first.
I do not understand such things yet.
My flower has not opened.
I am waiting for it to open.
Do not laugh at me.

lines.zh: 我的藤蔓可以给你编个环
lines.en: My vine can be woven into a ring.

lines.zh: 我们就在林子里走走吧
lines.en: Let us just walk in the forest.
Shall we plant a tree together?
My leaves rustle; can you hear them?
I coil a vine around it.
I want to plant this fruit.
This fruit is not ripe yet.
It fell by the tree roots.
I carry it in my arms.
I will keep this for compost.
I have found another seed.
This is not good to eat.

lines.zh: 我的藤蔓缠住你的脚踝
lines.en: My vines wrap around your ankle
There is nothing worth taking on me.
I can let you pass.
Do not tread on my flowers.
I am calling my friends.
My vines can stretch very far.
I do not want to fight.
Can we not simply talk?
I follow you, but far off.
I fear you will tread on things.
I am watching where you go.
I hide behind a clump of grass.
My friends in the trees are watching.

lines.zh: 我用藤蔓缠住了一根枝
lines.en: I have hooked a vine on a branch.
If you chase, I run.
There are many paths here.
I never fight anybody head on.
I am going back.
I will move once it is dark.
I lash out with a vine.
That hardly hurt.
I push you with my hand.
I turn and run off.
These are my flowers.
The vine strikes your leg guard.
I do not want this kind of fight.
I bounce off you.
I retreat a long way.
I am close to crying.
The vine whips across your arm.
I come up through loose soil.

lines.zh: 身上的叶子还没抖干净
lines.en: Leaves still cling to me.
This is where I was born.
The bud on my head has just formed.
The forest is warm.
I shake the mud off me.
I settle and breathe slowly.
I want to put down roots here.
I walk toward the sunlight.
Fire nears and my leaf curls.
I fell out of the tree.
Water has soaked my roots soft.
The blast throws me against a trunk.
Something pierces my vine.
That force numbs my limbs.
Hunger is yellowing my leaves.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我全身一颤
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree and I shudder.
No soil here, and no light.
